verdict.rationale: LangSmith's first-party docs describe online evaluations: evaluators run automatically on production traces, covering safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics and reference-free LLM-as-judge, with filters and sampling rates to control cost. The docs present this real-time evaluation of live traffic as distinct from offline evaluation on curated datasets. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of online evaluators running on live traffic.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can run evaluators continuously on live production traffic, not just offline datasets

citations.quote: Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
Evaluate real user interactions in real-time to detect issues and measure quality on live traffic.
Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Run evaluations on curated datasets during development to compare versions, benchmark performance, and catch regressions.
